$comentario: Stock exits with a reason (F15, RN-99): the list, the registration screen and the reason catalog. Together because they share the product, quantity and cost labels.
exits_description: Goods that left the inventory without being sold: shrinkage, damage, expired, internal use. Each with its reason and its row in the stock ledger.
exits_none_hint: Record the first shrinkage or damage so it stays in the stock ledger with its reason.
exits_cancel_units: {units} units will be returned to the inventory, at the cost they left with.
exits_cancelled_ok: Exit voided; the stock is back.
exit_new_description: Choose the reason, add the products and review before confirming.
exit_no_lines: Search for a product to add it.
exit_cost_note: Valued at each product's average cost today; a product with no recorded purchases leaves at zero.
exit_lines_unreadable: The exit details could not be read.
reasons_description: Why goods leave. They are added, renamed and disabled; never deleted, because old exits name them.
reasons_code_hint: Short and without spaces. Not translated: it is the internal name.
reasons_system_note: "Stock count" is used by the stock count: it is not chosen in an exit and cannot be disabled.
